notes: Sources: 2018_02 is the MSP/MTA-UMass Lowell collective agreement, July 1, 2014 - June 30, 2017 (executed May 11, 2016), the governing document for the unit of full-time faculty and librarians. Its term ended before the reference date; the MSP homepage captured 2018-03-08 (2018_06, a navigation page with no policy) lists the 2014-2017 contract as current and says bargaining for a new contract has begun. The successor 2017-2018 Memorandum of Agreement (2018_03) and the 2018-2020 MoA (2018_04) were signed 2018-06-26, after the reference date, and their saved text is empty, as is the scan 2018_01. The agreement is read as in force on 2018-03-13.

2018_05 is UMass Trustee Policy T93-123 (Family Leave Policy, 1993, revised 1994); by its text it applies to non-unit employees, but the agreement's Art. XX B.6 implements it for bargaining unit members, so it is coded for the faculty (c10).

Main provisions: Art. XX B.3 Paid Parental/Adoptive Leave (c1: up to one semester, paid only from the member's own sick leave and then the colleague-funded Sick Leave Bank; payer own_balance under R1d, whose example is this very article, so it counts 0 paid weeks but counts as a leave in protected weeks); B.2 Maternity Leave (c2: 8 weeks unpaid, with up to 8 weeks of own sick-leave pay, c4, and a discretionary extension, c3); B.4 Unpaid Parental Leave (c8: up to one academic year, discretionary); B.5 Parental Postponement of TDY (c9: one year); B.6 FMLA via T93-123 (c10).

Paid parental leave and maternity leave are not linked: the paid parental semester is 'the semester in which the child's birth or adoption occurs or an adjacent semester', which places it in no relation to the 8-week maternity leave; under U3 they are not added.

Chain, birth parent: maternity leave 8 (c2; own sick-leave pay up to 8 within it, c4; discretionary extension after it, c3) | paid parental leave up to 1 semester (c1, own sick leave then the bank), unlinked to c2 | FMLA 12 concurrent_with c1 and c2, from the earliest | unpaid parental leave up to 1 academic year (c8, discretionary) also_available with c1, placed after it.

Chain, non-birth parent: paid parental leave up to 1 semester (c1) with FMLA 12 concurrent_with it | unpaid parental leave up to 1 academic year (c8, discretionary) also_available with c1, placed after it. Only one of two unit-member parents may take c1.
Calendar: the agreement uses semesters (Fall, Spring) and an academic year from September 1 to May 31, but states no term length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Not components: sabbatical leave and the non-tenured sabbatical/reduced workload (research purposes); funeral, military, court and other specific-purpose leaves (cannot be used for a birth); the Health and Welfare Fund (benefits unspecified); salary-rate rules for members on leave.

Cited but not saved: the 2017-2018 and 2018-2020 Memoranda of Agreement (saved files empty; signed after the reference date, said in their version note to amend only salary); Trustee Policy T92-031 (travel); T96-047 (outside activities); College Workload Implementation Guidelines; the Health and Welfare Fund trust agreement. None is cited for a parental provision. The sick-leave 'established practice' on charging days and on family-illness use (A.1.b) is unwritten practice, not a document.
Statutes: FMLA verified against statute text 2026_00 (29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(1): 12 workweeks) and 2026_01 (2611(2): 12 months, 1,250 hours). No Massachusetts statute is saved.
